items.stem: A workload needs consistent, high-bandwidth, low-latency connectivity between on-prem and AWS. Which is most appropriate?

options.rationale: Correct: Direct Connect provides a dedicated, consistent high-bandwidth link.

options.text: A single Site-to-Site VPN tunnel over the internet
options.rationale: VPN over the internet has variable latency and lower, less consistent throughput.
Health checks are DNS failover, not connectivity.
CloudFront is a CDN, not a hybrid link.

items.stem: Which TWO improve resilience of hybrid connectivity to AWS? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use both VPN tunnels (or a VPN as backup to Direct Connect)
options.rationale: Correct: redundant tunnels/links provide failover if one path fails.

options.text: Connect many VPCs and on-prem through a Transit Gateway hub
options.rationale: Correct: a TGW hub simplifies and centralizes resilient connectivity.

options.text: Rely on a single VPN tunnel with no backup
options.rationale: A single tunnel is a single point of failure.

options.text: Disable route propagation so routes stay static forever
options.rationale: Disabling propagation harms failover and dynamic routing.

items.explanation: Correct: Use both VPN tunnels (or a VPN as backup to Direct Connect), Connect many VPCs and on-prem through a Transit Gateway hub.

items.stem: What is a correct statement about AWS Direct Connect security?

options.text: Direct Connect is private but not encrypted by default; add encryption (e.g., a VPN over it) if required
options.rationale: Correct: Direct Connect is a private link but is not encrypted unless you add encryption.

options.text: Direct Connect encrypts all traffic automatically with no action
options.rationale: Direct Connect is not encrypted by default.

options.text: Direct Connect is the same as a public internet VPN
options.rationale: Direct Connect is a dedicated private connection, not internet VPN.

options.text: Direct Connect requires no routing configuration

items.explanation: Correct: Direct Connect is private but not encrypted by default; add encryption (e.g., a VPN over it) if required.
